source: Emulated machine and hardware: Atari system model, OS and BASIC ROMs, RAM expansions, and add-on hardware.  Most take effect after a restart.
effective_source: Emulated machine and hardware: Atari system model, OS and BASIC ROMs, RAM expansions, and add-on hardware.  Most take effect after a restart.

source: Select system emulated.  Atari 5200 for Atari 5200 console games.  400/800 (OS B) for <48K games or ones that require OS/B.  800XL (64K) works for most content.  130XE (128K), Modern XL/XE(320K Compy Shop),  Modern XL/XE(576K), Modern XL/XE(1088K) for content that needs more than 64K.  Atari XE Game System for the Atari XE Game System or XEGS console games.

Atari XE Game System for the Atari XE Game System or XEGS console games.

source: Enable for content that needs Atari BASIC in order to run.  A proper ROM file (ATARIBAS.ROM) is needed.
effective_source: Enable for content that needs Atari BASIC in order to run.  A proper ROM file (ATARIBAS.ROM) is needed.

source: Select the operating-system ROM revision used by the Atari 400/800. 'Auto' picks a revision automatically. 'AltirraOS' uses the bundled open-source replacement ROM (no original ROM required). Other revisions require the matching ROM file in the system directory.

source: Emulate the Mosaic RAM expansion (Atari 400/800 only). Adds RAM-select boards mapped at $4000-$7FFF. Mutually exclusive with the Axlon expansion.
effective_source: Emulate the Mosaic RAM expansion (Atari 400/800 only). Adds RAM-select boards mapped at $4000-$7FFF. Mutually exclusive with the Axlon expansion.

source: Emulate the Axlon 128K-compatible bank-switched RAM expansion (Atari 400/800 only). Mutually exclusive with the Mosaic expansion.
effective_source: Emulate the Axlon 128K-compatible bank-switched RAM expansion (Atari 400/800 only). Mutually exclusive with the Mosaic expansion.

source: The real Axlon board mirrored its bank-select register at $0FC0-$0FFF; some compatibles did not. Enable for full Axlon compatibility.
effective_source: The real Axlon board mirrored its bank-select register at $0FC0-$0FFF; some compatibles did not. Enable for full Axlon compatibility.

source: Enable MapRAM RAM-under-ROM mapping (Atari XL/XE only), mirroring the OS ROM into RAM for a small speed-up used by some enhanced systems.
effective_source: Enable MapRAM RAM-under-ROM mapping (Atari XL/XE only), mirroring the OS ROM into RAM for a small speed-up used by some enhanced systems.

source: Emulate the XEP80 80-column display interface on the chosen joystick port.  Requires the XEP80 charset ROM.
effective_source: Emulate the XEP80 80-column display interface on the chosen joystick port.  Requires the XEP80 charset ROM.

source: Emulate the ICD R-Time 8 real-time clock cartridge.
effective_source: Emulate the ICD R-Time 8 real-time clock cartridge.

source: Emulates the Atari Stereo Sound Mod (second POKEY chip at $D210-$D21F on 800/XL/XE). Stock 800/XL/XE has only one POKEY -- leave this disabled for authentic behavior. Some games (Bounty Bob Strikes Back, Road Race) use POKEY register mirroring tricks that lock up or lose audio when stereo is enabled. The Atari 5200 always uses mono regardless of this setting.

Some games (Bounty Bob Strikes Back, Road Race) use POKEY register mirroring tricks that lock up or lose audio when stereo is enabled. The Atari 5200 always uses mono regardless of this setting.

source: Configure 5200 Digital and Analog Joystick sensitivity and Analog deadzone.  Activate Swap, Dual Joysticks or Joy 2B+. Activate Paddle mode and set Paddle speed.  Set retroarch keyboard type.
effective_source: Configure 5200 Digital and Analog Joystick sensitivity and Analog deadzone.  Activate Swap, Dual Joysticks or Joy 2B+. Activate Paddle mode and set Paddle speed.  Set retroarch keyboard type.

source: Apply gamepad input hacks required for specific games. 'Dual Stick' maps Player 2's joystick to the right analog stick of Player 1's RetroPad, enabling dual stick control in 'Robotron 2084' and 'Space Dungeon'. 'Swap Ports' maps Player 1 to port 2 and Player 2 to port 1 of the emulated console, correcting the swapped inputs of 'Wizard of Wor', 'Apple Panic' and a few other games. 'Joy 2B+' enables multibutton joysticks support.

'Joy 2B+' enables multibutton joysticks support.

source: Determines how fast the paddle will move.

source: Set the effective range of the emulated analog joystick when using the gamepad's digital D-Pad for movement. Lower values equate to slower speeds.  Also can be used to make games like Centipede, Kaboom, Missile Command, Pengo, Realsports Tennis, Pole Position, Xari Arena and Super Breakout more playable.
